# Meet Mech: Your Metal Beast 
Going in naked? That’s a suicide mission. Hop into BUST, a massive mecha with overwhelming size and raw destructive power. We've got the heavy artillery ready—get in, and start stomping those freaks into the dirt.
[media]

# WHAT THE...?! FREAKIN' ZOMBIES! 
Nightmarish Creatures Everywhere
The world is crawling with mutated freaks. From bloated giants to winged horrors diving from the sky—think you can take them all down?
[media]

# Friends or Foes? 
Zombies aren't your only problem. In this world, other players are part of the chaos. Will they be your squadmates or your next target? Kill or be killed—it’s time to prove who's the real boss.
[media]

# The Endless Apocalypse 
From barren deserts and lava fields to toxic gas zones—this viral hellscape is only getting bigger. New zones are constantly unfolding. Are you ready to explore?
[media]
